title: AS2: EventDispatcher class pattern
description: Add an EventDispatcher runtime pattern test. In AS2, EventDispatcher.initialize(obj) is commonly called to add addEventListener, removeEventListener, dispatchEvent to an object. Write a test in packages/core/src/as2/__tests__/eventdispatcher.test.ts that compiles: EventDispatcher.initialize(this); this.addEventListener('click', handler); this.dispatchEvent({type:'click'}); Ensure it compiles without error and check for relevant opcodes. Also test class Foo extends EventDispatcher {} syntax compiles.
